system.description: You gain a follower that is a level 2 beast of your size or smaller that accompanies you and follows your instructions. You and your GM must work out the appearance and personality of your beast. Its movement is based on its creature type (avian, swimmer, and so on). If your beast companion dies, you can use your resource points to revive them or (by hunting in the wild for a few days) locate and befriend a new one. When working out the details of your follower, you might decide you'd like an animated plant companion rather than an animal.
